Hi Jordan / Samantha 

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we're all aligned and can surface the mutual action plan (MAP) for Procurement/IT review:

Summary of pain & goals
- Pain: High inference cost and inconsistent latency on current endpoints as Acme scales from pilot -> production.
- Primary goal: < 200ms p95 inference for customer-facing features and a 40% reduction in per-token cost vs current provider for batch workloads.
- Constraints: Must meet Acme's SOC 2 requirements and support VPC deployment for sensitive data.

Key stakeholders we identified
- Jordan Ellis  Product (decision-maker)
- Samantha Lee  ML Platform (technical evaluator)
- Michael Park  Procurement (contracts & timeline)
- Redwood owners: Marissa Cole (AE), Lauren Bishop (Sales Ops), Rishi Malhotra (SE)

Proposed MAP & milestones (draft)
1) Technical POC kickoff  week of 2026-09-27 (owner: Rishi). Deliverable: VPC test instance + sample throughput/latency baseline.
2) Security/compliance review  2026-10-04 (owner: Marissa). Deliverable: SOC2 evidence, network diagram, data handling docs.
3) Performance tuning & cost forecast  2026-10-11 (owner: Rishi). Deliverable: tuned rig, quantization profile, estimated unit costs.
4) Final evaluation & contract review  2026-10-18 (owner: Michael + Marissa). Deliverable: decision and SOW/PO.

Immediate next steps (for this week)
- Rishi to share POC plan and required access  target: 2026-09-22. (Attached: redwood-map-MAP-v1.pdf)
- Jordan to confirm analytics sample dataset and expected qps for pilot.
- Michael to confirm expected procurement timeline and if Purchase Order is required before POC.

Attachments included: redwood-map-MAP-v1.pdf (draft MAP), soc2-snapshot.pdf (SOC2 attestation snapshot)

If that looks right, I'll update the MAP spreadsheet and share an updated copy with dates and owners. Proposed follow-up: 30-minute sync next Tue 2026-09-22 10:00am PT to lock access and kickoff actions.

Thanks

- For the POC, our initial qps will be ~250 sustained with spikes to 600 during peak. Our priority is p95 latency under 200ms for the UI flows.
- Samantha will be the main technical contact for onboarding; I'll include her in access requests.
- On procurement: we generally avoid issuing a PO before a successful technical eval, but can fast-track SOW once performance and SOC2 checks look good.

The proposed timeline looks good. Confirming the 9/22 10:00am PT sync works for me and Samantha. Michael, please weigh in on procurement timing  do you need any specific docs ahead of the call?
